domains.name: Quantitative Techniques and Data Interpretation (Arithmetic, Algebra, DI)
Logical Reasoning (Analytical Reasoning, Statement-Conclusion, Blood Relations)
General Awareness (Current Affairs, Business, Economy, Static GK)

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain focuses primarily on quantitative techniques and data interpretation, covering arithmetic, algebra, and related mathematical problems to test your basic mathematical skills thoroughly for success.

This section covers logical reasoning competencies completely, including analytical reasoning puzzles, statement-conclusion relationships, and complex blood relations to assess your reasoning abilities effectively during the evaluation process.

This specific domain evaluates language comprehension through reading comprehension passages, standard vocabulary questions, and regular grammar exercises to measure your overall communication skills required for management education.

This part examines general awareness regarding current affairs, business developments, the national economy, and static GK topics to ensure candidates possess a broad knowledge base for professional success.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at your assigned test center fully prepared for a 180-minute computer-based online test administered in a single session. Manage your time across all 100 questions carefully.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of a total of 100 questions divided evenly across four distinct domains, covering quantitative techniques, logical reasoning, language comprehension, and general awareness.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Official passing score details and cutoff marks are set individually by the admitting institutions and NTA guidelines; please check with NTA directly for specific admission criteria.
The test has a strict duration of 180 minutes and is conducted in a single session as a computer-based online examination at designated test centers.
The exam price is ₹2,000 (~$24 USD) for general candidates and ₹1,000 for SC, ST, PwBD, and female candidates registering for the test.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare comprehensively for the CMAT exam administered by NTA. Review quantitative techniques, logical reasoning, language comprehension, and general awareness

methodology.summary: This complete overview was built using official NTA exam guides and documentation to outline the structure, domains, and administrative details of the test.

editorial.overview: The CMAT (Common Management Admission Test) is a premier national level entrance examination designed for entry into management programmes. Administered by NTA, this online test evaluates candidates across quantitative techniques, logical reasoning, language comprehension, and general awareness to help institutions select suitable graduate candidates for admission into various courses across the country.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review arithmetic and algebra principles properly, practice logical reasoning problems consistently, build your vocabulary for reading comprehension exercises, and stay updated on business, economy, and general awareness topics. Work through practice sets covering all four domains to prepare adequately for the single-session computer-based test comprising a total of 100 questions.
editorial.who_should_take: Graduate candidates seeking admission into AICTE-Approved Institutions, University Departments, Constituent Colleges, and Affiliated Colleges for professional management programs should take this specific test to advance their careers.

exam_rules: Computer Based Test (CBT) for most exams (NEET UG is pen-and-paper OMR). No calculators, mobile phones, or study materials. Negative marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (NEET, JEE), -1 mark (CUET), -1 mark (UGC-NET).
id_requirements: Admit card + valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar preferred; Passport, Driving Licence also accepted)

prerequisites.description: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST); or final year degree students

retake_policy.notes: JEE Main is held twice a year; NEET once a year; UGC-NET twice a year; CUET once a year
